root: ^I served The King valiantly for most of my life. After a few months this new lowly scoundrel dares to claim His seat and accuse me of killing MY KING! It was the only night I slept in the other wing of the castle, which clearly was a ploy to get me away from him.

^Our predecessors made sure that wrongful judgements and coup d’etats could be reversed. I know a way out but it requires battling skills, which I do not have. In the likely chance I won’t survive, look for metal sticks from the predators.
^I’m sure I won’t be the last victim the New High Council sends here. We need everyone fighting the new regime, be it criminal or not.
